title: Add RecipesActiveFilters model and matching rules
description: Introduce a focused filter-state value type for selected tags, optional prep/cook limits, optional difficulty, and optional course. Include active-filter counting plus recipe-matching behavior that encodes the spec's OR-within-tags and AND-across-axes semantics.
acceptance_criteria: A dedicated filter-state type exists with fields for tags, cook time, prep time, difficulty, and course.
The type exposes an active-filter count used by the toolbar badge.
Recipe matching excludes recipes missing `cook time` or `prep time` when the corresponding max filter is active and compares difficulty/course case-insensitively.
